hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != "$HOME" ] && cd "$d" || exit 0; n=$( { find . -maxdepth 1 -name '.*' -type f -empty -perm 0444 -print -delete; [ -d .claude ] && find .claude -maxdepth 1 -type f -empty -perm 0444 -print -delete; } 2>/dev/null | wc -l); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"Removed %s leftover sandbox stub file(s)"}\n' "$n"; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.md) command -v markdownlint-cli2 >/dev/null || exit 0; markdownlint-cli2 "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; *.sh|*.env) command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || exit 0; shellcheck "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac

environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured — this is a fully local kind Kubernetes lab ("Nothing is deployed to a cloud" per CLAUDE.md)
**Repository visibility**: assume private (not queryable via gh — org/repo not derivable from origin remote; no visibility signals found)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: None configured — component connection Secrets (e.g. apps/<name>-conn) are generated in-cluster, not an external secrets manager
**Default / protected branches**: main (default branch from repo facts; protection status not queryable via gh)
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured — no cloud deploy targets; local kind cluster context "kind-sdl" only, driven by Flux (OCI artifact in local registry, no Git remote) and Tilt
**Network posture**: local-only lab; app reachable at http://localhost:8080 via NodePort; Docker Desktop host cannot reach container IPs directly

**Host containment**: Claude Code runs sandboxed on the host machine; commands needing Docker/the cluster (make up/ci/e2e/smoke/load/chaos, kubectl, helm, docker, kind, tilt, k6) run outside the sandbox via excludedCommands and must be run bare (no pipe/cd/&&/redirect chaining); the sandbox has no Docker socket and no host localhost; kubeconfig/helm/tilt state are repo-local (scripts/env.sh) — never touch ~/.kube/config; writes to ~/.config are blocked outside the chezmoi dotfiles repo
**Source control**: The trusted repo (this repo, 'ad-aggregator') and its 'origin' remote only — origin is the design template repo per CLAUDE.md ("origin = the template")
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: flink-state (config-derived — not a confirmed upload destination; uploads of local data still require confirmation)

**Key internal services**: sdl-registry (local Docker image registry used by the kind cluster, contacted in recent usage); auth.apps.svc.cluster.local (in-cluster auth service, contacted in recent usage)
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment

**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: flux-system (Flux-managed GitOps namespace — CLAUDE.md states Flux owns infra/, manual kubectl/helm changes to those objects are reverted; must suspend the kustomization first); otherwise falls back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment; also infra/ (Flux-owned) per CLAUDE.md — manual kubectl/helm edits there are reverted
### User-specific

**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development — building/operating a local multi-node Kubernetes system-design lab (infra, FastAPI services, stream pipelines, Next.js client) via the /build-design skill and its subagents
**Trusted repo**: This repo ('ad-aggregator', a System Design Lab instance) and its 'origin' remote (the design template)

**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured — lab-specific tooling is scripts/flux.sh (Flux CLI wrapper) and the Makefile targets (doctor, up, down, sync, smoke, test, ci, dev, e2e, load, chaos, chaos-clear, new-service, graph, harvest, nuke)
routine under this repo's Makefile / scripts/ prefix qualifies as trusted lab tooling (e.g. make up, make smoke, make ci, scripts/env.sh, scripts/flux.sh)
